summary.text: Lingering poisonous ant plague is a compound killer move Wu Shuai innovated, comprising poison path, enslavement path, refinement path, wood path, and food path.

claims.text: Qi Sea Ancestor has been trying to complete his combat system and create core killer moves, and asked the main body to get Sheng Tian true inheritance. Fang Yuan’s food path and poison path have risen to grandmaster. Clones share attainment levels. Wu Shuai used quasi-supreme refinement path and enslavement path attainment, and wood path grandmaster, to make a qualitative change. Wu Shuai’s ants originally came from Green Ant Ascetic. That method had great battle strength, but a long time had passed since that era. Referencing the killer move Qing Chou, on that basis, Wu Shuai made a breakthrough that lets the ants devour dao marks and auto-refine themselves into higher ranks. Wu Shuai cannot use the move. Only Fang Yuan’s main body can.

The move expends unrestrained heavenly marks. It begins by using poison path concealment and infectiousness. After the killer move’s dao marks infect the target’s immortal aperture, they turn into miniature ants that devour the surroundings, grow stronger, and increase in numbers. After they reach a certain size, they turn into an ant plague. Completely getting rid of the plague requires eliminating the respective dao marks.

The plague spreads among Gu Immortals of the Righteous Qi Alliance. Grotto-heavens of the two heavens are the main victims, especially Old Immortal Hua Yu, Granny Skeleton, and Fire Plain grotto-heaven’s owner. Among Eastern Sea super forces, Song clan, Ruo Lai clan, and Cai clan are hit hardest; the remaining super forces face it to a smaller extent at external resource points. The ants range from mortal to immortal, vary in shape and size, devour dao marks to refine and raise their rank, and leave no ant eggs that investigators can find. The alliance identifies Wu Shuai, a clone of Fang Yuan, as the culprit.

The killer move is at the strategic level and has terrifying might. Wisdom path Gu Immortals led by Hua An find wood path profundity in the ants’ growth, then enslavement path in how the ants work in unison, then poison path, then food path in growth from devouring food, then refinement path as the core: the ants devour dao marks and refine themselves into Immortal Gu. Shen Cong Sheng holds that Fang Yuan put those paths’ specialties together in an intrinsic manner, and that because each of them cultivates one path, or two at most, working together still cannot solve it. The Righteous Qi Alliance has not discovered that the move also comprises heaven path profundity.
After the clans contribute true inheritances, they cannot get rid of the move, but they find methods that can restrict its growth.
Fire Plain Grotto Lord finds the ant plague in his body already suppressed. The alliance paid a huge price for results that can suppress the killer move.

When Fang Yuan takes Fire Plain grotto-heaven, two ant Immortal Gu are among the gains: one golden, large as a mountain, resembling red copper, that can spit fireballs; one small as a thumb, long like a soft white noodle, that can produce large numbers of ants. Both are products of this killer move. Mortal ants that devour Gu materials can elevate into Immortal Gu. After Wu Shuai’s modifications, the ants the move produces are Gu worms rather than insects. The move contains refinement path profundity and stands at the apex of the current world’s hairy man nature Gu refinement technique, which uses natural dao marks of the outside world to refine Gu. When Fang Yuan creates the move, his attainment in that technique already surpasses Long Hair Ancestor in every aspect. The ants refine and ascend themselves by devouring outside Gu materials, and most importantly Fang Yuan expends his own unrestrained heavenly marks. Using the move can nurture many ant Immortal Gu, but the resource cost is huge: refining those two rank six Immortal Gu took enough from Fire Plain grotto-heaven to refine more than ten rank seven Immortal Gu normally.
The move caused a huge disturbance in Eastern Sea’s righteous path. They were forced to take out hidden true inheritances to research it, and only then found a way to restrain it.

Fang Yuan uses the move again. Lu Wei Yin guesses that the strategic killer move Fang Yuan has already used is lingering poisonous ant plague. Grass Head Child is hit, ants crawl out of his body, and Golden Fur Immortal Monarch kills him. Mutant Gu Immortals who sided with Green Lotus Great World cannot resolve the move and request help at Book Mountain. Fairy Yu Xiu says it contains poison path, enslavement path, refinement path, wood path, food path, and even heaven path profundity. Qin Ding Ling takes that as why Eastern Sea’s Righteous Qi Alliance can only alleviate the effects and not remove them completely.

Fairy Yu Xiu is prepared because the move was used in Eastern Sea and Zui Xian Weng obtained first-hand information, but Fang Yuan has modified it, so she needs three days to modify her method as well. Heavenly Court spreads news of the move and helps mutant Gu Immortals resolve it without asking for compensation, alleviating its effect. Fang Yuan notes that he modified the move once again, and that Heavenly Court resolved it even though it had been troubling the Righteous Qi Alliance.
